Tools, Migrators, and Connectors
Copy page

MongoDB has tools and integrations for development and management, including database management, integration, migration, and data visualization. See the following section to find the right tool for your use case. To browse tools by category, see the reference table later on this page.

Choose the Tool For Your Use Case

The following table maps common tasks to their corresponding tools:

Task
	
Tools



Migrate from a relational database

	

Relational Migrator




Sync data between clusters

	

Mongosync




Connect BI and visualization tools

	

BI Connector, SQL Interface, Atlas Charts




Work from your IDE or AI assistant

	

VS Code Extension, IntelliJ Plugin, MongoDB MCP Server

Explore your data

	

Compass, MongoDB Shell

CLIs and Utilities

Atlas CLI

Manage your MongoDB Atlas deployment from the command line.

MongoDB CLI

Administer Cloud Manager and Ops Manager deployments from the command line.

MongoDB Shell

Test queries and interact with your MongoDB database from the command line.

Database Tools

Export data from one MongoDB cluster to a JSON, BSON, CSV, or TSV file and import it to another MongoDB cluster.

Connectors

SQL Interface

Simplify exporting your MongoDB data to SQL-driven tools with native driver support for all deployment types.

BI Connector

Connect MongoDB to your favorite BI platforms to visualize, graph, and report on your MongoDB data.

Kafka Connector

Build robust pipelines that stream events between applications with MongoDB and Apache Kafka.

Spark Connector

Leverage Apache Spark's libraries to analyze MongoDB data with machine learning, graph, and SQL APIs.

IDE and AI Integrations

MongoDB MCP Server

Interact with your MongoDB data and deployments from your agentic AI tools, assistants, and platforms.

C# Analyzer

Understand and troubleshoot queries and aggregations directly inside Visual Studio and other tools.

VS Code Extension

Manage your data directly within your coding environment.

IntelliJ Plugin

Build applications and work with your MongoDB data directly from IntelliJ IDEA.

Migrators

Mongosync

Continuously synchronize data between MongoDB clusters in the same or hybrid environments, including Atlas, private cloud, on-premises, and at the edge.

Relational Migrator

Migrate data from your relational database to MongoDB.

Management Tools

Cloud Manager

Use the hosted management platform to monitor, automate, and backup self-managed deployments.

Ops Manager

Deploy, monitor, back up, and scale MongoDB on your own infrastructure.

Partner Integrations

Render

Connect your Render-hosted applications to an Atlas cluster.

Vercel

Connect your Atlas clusters to applications that you deploy using Vercel.

Azure

Connect your Atlas organizations with Microsoft Azure.

Visualization

Atlas Charts

Create, share, and embed visualizations of MongoDB data.

Compass

Interact with your data through a graphical interface.
